page.layout: One page of verse in a single column, with a catchword "Ad" at the lower right. Marginal marks on the right side are scattered ornaments or pointing marks, not text.

main_text.l: Semper ad occasum sese ut convertat ab ortu,
Quoq; abiit redeat totiesq; abiens rediensq;
Observet sedem veluti non mobilis unam.
At vero quinque errones Tstaniaque[?] astra
Quamuis perpetua lustrent vertigine terras,
Semper & in partem quam stellifer orbis eandem
Nitantur, tamen haud aquis sua passibus urgent,
Lumina, sed lento magis ignis redituque recursu:
Quo magis ad terram quisque inclinatur inertem,
Scilicet ingentes cum fingeret aetheris orbes
Caelituum pater, atque hominum formaret ad usus:
Proxima quae nostros incurrunt lumina visus,
Si tam praecipiti vertigine torta[?] mearent,
Quamgremio quae cuncta suo suprema coercet,
Machina, tam celeres spectantia lumina motus
Deficerent, hebetesque oculos caligo repente
Conderet, ad nullosque usus properatio motus
Apta foret, paucis Phoebea recurreret horis
Et fugeret lampas, nec tempora commoda somno,
Nox brevis, aut praeceps lux opportuna labori
Diuideret, totiesque reduces cum sole tenebrae,
Omnia turbarent operum momenta, nec estas
Concoqueret fruges, nec dulces pallor in uvas
Serperet, & lente mutesceret acer amaror,
Gleba necexiguo putrescens frigore venis
Imbiberet cupidis genitales aetheris imbres,
Nec breue ver blandos florum spiraret odores,
Sed properata astas veris spoliaret honorem,
Pelleret aestatem autumnus, dum messis in herba
Turgeret: deformis hyems infixma[?] necaret,
Semina, sollicitis spem deceptura colonis.
Ergo ille aetherij elemens[?] moderator Olympi,

page.notes: The last line's end and the catchword "Ad" are partly obscured by smudges. Several words are doubtful: "Tstaniaque" (possibly a printing error for Stanique), "torta", "infixma", "elemens", and the abbreviated "Quoq;" and "q;" forms are kept as printed. Long s is normalised to s throughout. Marginal marks on the right are not transcribed.
